findings.summary: The page renders no loading indicator while q.isLoading is true — during initial load the user sees an empty screen (no spinner, skeleton, or text), unlike every other feature page.
findings.fix: Add a loading branch consistent with the app pattern, e.g. right after the error/empty checks: {q.isLoading ? <section className="space-y-3" aria-label="جارٍ تحميل الإشعارات">{[1,2,3].map(i=><div key={i} className="card h-24 animate-pulse bg-[var(--surface-muted)]" />)}</section> : null} (matching LiveLocationPage/ServiceDeskPage skeleton style).

findings.summary: The 'تعليم الكل كمقروء' header action is a bespoke button with hand-rolled border/padding/font classes instead of reusing the shared .btn-secondary class.
findings.fix: Replace the inline className with the shared primitive: className="btn-secondary" (keep the CheckCheck icon + gap), so the button matches the design-system button height, radius, hover/disabled states.

findings.summary: The 'فتح' link is a bespoke primary button (bg-brand px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-white) instead of reusing the shared .btn-primary class used for primary CTAs elsewhere.
findings.fix: Change the Link className to "btn-primary text-sm" so it inherits the standard primary-button gradient/tokens, radius, and states.

findings.summary: Multiple hardcoded brand utilities (text-brand, bg-brand, border-brand/40) are used instead of design tokens; the 'جديد' badge and unread-border rely on ad-hoc brand classes rather than --brand-primary / --brand-primary-soft tokens.
findings.fix: Use token-based styling: unread border via border-[var(--brand-primary)]/soft, the 'جديد' badge via bg-[var(--brand-primary)] text-white, and the bell icon via text-[var(--brand-primary)], matching the tokenized approach used in LoadingScreen and other pages.

findings.summary: The error state uses EmptyState instead of the app's error-banner pattern, and when q.isError is true the empty-state check can also evaluate, but more importantly an errored fetch shows a generic empty look rather than a distinct danger-styled banner.
findings.fix: Render the error as a danger banner (e.g. a .card with border/text using --danger tokens and role="alert") separate from the neutral EmptyState, so failed loads are visually distinct from 'no notifications'.

findings.summary: The unread state is conveyed only via opacity/border/color and a 'جديد' badge without a text alternative on the item itself, and the bell icon span has no aria-hidden, adding noise to screen readers.
findings.fix: Add aria-hidden="true" to the decorative bell icon span, and ensure unread status is programmatically exposed (e.g. aria-label on the article indicating 'غير مقروء'), avoiding reliance on color/opacity alone.

findings.summary:
The notification date is rendered as a raw formatted string in a

with no element or machine-readable datetime, reducing semantic clarity.
findings.fix: Wrap the formatted date in <time dateTime={new Date(n.createdAt).toISOString()}>…</time> for semantic/a11y correctness.
